Title: Cyrena.Coding.Extension - ProjectInformation Plugin
Summary: Semantic Kernel plugin for project plan access and sticky note CRUD.
Content:
## ProjectInformation (Semantic Kernel Plugin)

**Namespace:** `Cyrena.Coding.Services`
**Assembly:** `Cyrena.Coding.Extension`

### Purpose
Semantic Kernel plugin for accessing project plan and managing sticky notes.

### Constructor
```csharp
internal class ProjectInformation
{
    public ProjectInformation(IDevelopPlanService plan, IStore<StickyNote> notes, IChatMessageService context);
}
```

### Kernel Functions

| Function | Description | Parameters |
|----------|-------------|------------|
| `get_plan` | Returns `DevelopPlanAIModel` with files, folders, and notes | none |
| `create_note` | Creates new sticky note | `title`, `content` |
| `update_note` | Updates existing note | `id`, `title` (optional), `content` (optional) |
| `delete_note` | Deletes note by ID | `id` |

### DevelopPlanAIModel
```csharp
public class DevelopPlanAIModel : DevelopPlan
{
    public List<StickyNote> Notes { get; set; }
}
```

### Return Types
- `DevelopPlanAIModel` for `get_plan`
- `ToolResult<string>` for note operations (returns note ID or error)
